title: Todoist Priority-One Aging
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=todoist:task priority=4
| stats max(days_open) as max_days_open, count as task_count by project
| where max_days_open>7
| sort - max_days_open
description: Uses Todoist priority tasks telemetry to monitor how long top-priority work has been sitting open in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for critical tasks that are aging beyond comfort, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Todoist priority tasks data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Project table of oldest priority-one task.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how long top-priority work has been sitting open so you can spot critical tasks that are aging beyond comfort before it becomes annoying.
